system.description:
A trained law enforcement marksman — crowd control, warning shots, precision at urban ranges.

  • Precision Placement: Called Shot (Leg) no longer requires declaring before rolling — can be applied to any hit once per round.
  • Badge and Barrel: Advantage on checks identifying criminals by description, navigating Holfast's legal system, and as a witness or enforcer of Holfast law.
